messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick update — starting Monday 2026-04-05 the corporate card single-purchase limit will increase to $5,000 for Marketing and Customer Ops. Please route any purchase >$5k via PO through the Supplier Portal. :memo: https://redwood.example.com/finance/vendor-portal

Alex Chen: Thanks Maria — does this change affect contractor reimbursements or contractors on vcards?

Maria Gomez: Contractors are unaffected for reimbursements — still capped at $500 per purchase. Contractors should submit via Expensify and tag the expense with `contractor`. For any exception, use the Vendor Exception form in the portal.

Zachary Li: Can we get a quick GL mapping to share with *product* and accounting? I can push to the shared spreadsheet.

Maria Gomez: Added core mappings below — please use these when creating POs or coding expenses:

```
MKT-AD: 4501
MKT-SW: 4502
OPS-SVCS: 5200
CONTRACTOR: 6100
INFRA-SW: 5305
```

FinOps Bot: Auto-approve window updated: purchases <$200 auto-approved; $200–$5,000 require manager approval + finance review. Exceptions will route to procurement for final signoff.

Elaine Park: Heads-up for Product/Infra — upcoming model infra purchases are likely to hit the new threshold. Can we slot a quick sync?

Maria Gomez: Absolutely. @Elaine Park let's do a 15-min sync to align on expected spend and PO lead times. Who else should join? @Zachary Li @Alex Chen

Alex Chen: I'm in. :raising_hand:

Zachary Li: Me too. Also, can we confirm virtual card mapping for recurring SaaS? Need to avoid double-billing.

Maria Gomez: Yes — vcard mapping and horizontal rules for recurring SaaS are documented in the portal under "Virtual Card Mapping". For temporary trial cards, request via the `virtual-card` workflow and include vendor contact + trial window.

Alex Chen: Got it. I'll update the team and circulate the PO checklist. :thumbsup:

Elaine Park: Thanks — will schedule the sync for Monday 11:00 AM PST and invite infra leads.

Maria Gomez: Quick reminder before I sign off — receipts must be uploaded within 7 days of charge or the transaction will be flagged for manual review. If you see a flagged charge, ping #finance and include the transaction ID. Thanks everyone!
